sources.snippet: Overview A research-oriented Flamingo prototype targeting Retrieval. The included large setup documents defaults and file formats without presenting unverified performance numbers.

sources.title: OpenFlamingo: Open-Source Vision–Language Model
sources.snippet: OpenFlamingo is an open-source vision–language model suite that combines a frozen vision encoder with large language models to advance multimodal AI research.
